'''Marren Dask''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] who served in the [[Rift Alliance]]'s Coalition Force during the [[Galactic War]]. He was [[Death/Legends|killed]] on [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]] by the [[White Maw]] [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]], [[Valon (pirate)|Valon]]. His mother, [[Lahanna Dask]], was the CEO of [[Belazura Sensor Technologies]], who made arrangements to annually donate a portion of her salary to the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] after Valon was imprisoned.
